name: jesl
title_zh: JSON 写流程，Effect-TS 跑编排的脚本语
tagline_zh: 不想碰 TypeScript 类型体操，又想要 Effect 的健壮性？用 JSON 描述步骤、分支、重试。
tagline_en: Skip TS type gymnastics, keep Effect's robustness. Describe steps, branches, retries in JSON; the engine handles.
desc_en: JSON Effect Scripting Language — a workflow engine on Effect-TS
why_zh: 把 Effect 的编排能力藏进 JSON 结构，声明式定义工作流，运行时统一处理超时、重试。
why_en: Hides Effect's orchestration power behind JSON structure. Declarative workflows with built-in timeout, retry, DI — cuts.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Effect-TS 生态，非 TS 项目装不上；JSON 描述复杂条件逻辑会绕，超过三层嵌套建议直接写 TS。
limit_en: Effect-TS only; non-TS projects can't use it. JSON gets awkward past 3 nested conditionals — write TS directly then.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
